entities.summary: Chaozhou Nanchun High School is a high school in Chaozhou, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. The school was founded in 1976, and currently has more than 2000 students, 208 full-time teachers, nine graduate students, and 138 senior teachers. The campus covers an area of 17,000 square meters.
